question: Asad Ali Khan was an Indian musician who played ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudra Veena.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asad Ali Khan** was an Indian musician who played **Rudra Veena, **a stringed instrument that originated in ancient India and is known for its **deep, resonant sound.**
 
• The Rudra Veena is a** difficult instrument** to play and requires years of practice and dedication to master.
 
• Asad Ali Khan was one of the foremost exponents of the Rudra Veena and was known for his **virtuosity and skill **on the instrument.
 
• In addition to his performances, Asad Ali Khan also taught the Rudra Veena to students and was instrumental in **preserving and promoting the tradition** of this ancient instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Flute** is a** wind instrument.**
 
• **Sitar** is a plucked **string** instrument.
 
• **Santoor** is a **hammered** dulcimer.
